title: Workzone 2-in-1 Workshop Creeper/Stool $39.99 @ ALDI
body:
Deal: Workzone 2-in-1 Workshop Creeper/Stool $39.99 @ ALDI

[ShootingStar3388] Thanks OP, looks like Bunnings has price-matched a similar one that they stock, with a lifetime guarantee, but unsure whether it's any good - https://www.bunnings.com.au/trojan-convertible-garage-creepe…
[Spacexyz] TROJAN looks and sounds sicker than WORKZONE😂.
[Jackson] Interesting to see trojan diversifying their rubber products. Could never understand why they would want their product associated with a system of delivering invaders secretly via a wooden horse
[Alley Cat] Most of the reviews say the wheels fall off lol Am I the only one read the reviews?
[co doonunda] Great thing about Aldi they force Bunnings to have at least some competitive pricing
[Lord Ra] Yep, lie on your back down low and look up high.
Deffo creepy.
[danzha] Awesome, this can fill the creeper shaped hole in my life
[Dishcount] Got one in the past. Don't recommend, low quality.
Problems I faced:
- the riveted thread piece that holds the wheels in place got loose , it can't be tightened. Very quickly it will be missing a wheel (or 2).
- the extrusion for the frame is just a bit too thin for my liking, too thin to repair.
If your the sort of person that is ok with paying more for something that's quality and will last you forever then this isn't the stool for you.
If you need to buy this for a few upcoming jobs, and plan to throw it out after a year, then it's an ok deal.
[Dishcount] Bought 1 from aldi, and 1 from Supercheap.
Both were basically the exact same, pretty confident from same factory, just different colour/branding
So I'm 2 for 2 in buying cheap and getting penalised for it, I might be learning.
[resisting the urge] Only the third buy does it for the average OzB'gner.
Some more.
tbf, forking out $250 for a Snap-On is just beyond sense if you can bum around on a discounted cheapie, for now…
[Jackson] @resisting the urge: And truly if a wheel falls out you can probably spot weld it or find some other solution
[Jackson] I have the sca one, have had it for years and never took it out of the box. The reason was until a couple of years ago I didn't have a jack with enough lift to get the car high enough on my stands that I could comfortably lie under it while on a creeper (btw I have a creeper and this, have opened the only creeper). Unless you have a decent jack, this is probably going to be not very useful
[Caped Baldy] Thank you for your sacrifice and review.
[drift7rs] cheers, exact same design also is plastered all over aliexpress, good to know not to bother
[MoreHobbiesPls] if anyone is looking for a regular creeper stool version this one JE1136755 on temu is actually CAT brand and $40 cheaper than bunnings.
source: i risked it for the biscuit after seeing another review and won. now i have a stool for when i have to babysit my embroidery machine yay!
